fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: RecipientUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the recipient.

fields.name: WorkspaceId
fields.description: ItemId of the Workspace the event belongs to.

fields.name: ProjectId
fields.description: ItemId of the Project the event belongs to, if any.

fields.name: EventKey
fields.description: Event id; the ItemId is the UUIDv5 of event and recipient.

fields.name: ParamsJson
fields.description: JSON with message keys and params only.

fields.name: IsRead
fields.description: True once the recipient has read it.

fields.name: EmailStatus
fields.description: Email delivery state. One of: none|pending|sent|failed.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key <op>:<requestId>[:<n>], set by the server; unique index.
